title: Kid
description: A player's school-age character: a full, standard SF2E PC (see common/sf2e-common.schema.json#/$defs/pcStatblock) plus the campaign-specific fields that make a kid a kid — Anchors, ground-role rotation history, and the link to the Frame they pilot. Level 1 at campaign start, advances by narrative milestone rather than XP budget. One file per kid in data/characters/kids/.

player.description: Which player controls this kid and their paired Frame.

pronouns.description: Free text (e.g. "She/her", "They/them") -- induction terminal Page 7. The terminal offers suggestions but never invents an answer.

genderIdentity.description: Free text -- induction terminal Page 7. Distinct from ancestry/appearance; not an SF2E mechanical field.

appearance.description: Free-text appearance notes -- induction terminal Page 7.

age.description: Kids start at 17 — the city's charter age for civil-defense conscription eligibility. Load-bearing for the setting's premise; see design bible System Notes.

concept.description: One or two sentence character concept.

anchors.description: 2-3 player-written Anchors: a person, a belief, a need.

resonance.description: Only meaningful once this kid is piloting a Frame.

groundRoleHistory.description: Log of which ground role this kid played each Contact, to enforce the no-repeat-twice-in-a-row rotation rule.

framePilotedRef.description: id of the Frame this kid pilots.

intake.description: Session-zero answers from the induction terminal's Page 7 (banal texture questions) and Page 8 (bible §20's eight core questions), design/induction-terminal.md. Distinct from `anchors` -- raw answers, not yet distilled into the capped-at-3 Anchors, which stay collaborative work with the real player.
